baseline_models.mechanism: The measuring branch of خلق, the fixed six, and a temporal span present creation as apportioned accomplishment rather than an undifferentiated act.

activation_trace.role: Estimation and measurement make the creative act an ordered apportionment.
The number six fixes the apportionment.
A duration supplies temporal units for the ordered work.

changed_reading.before: God created the cosmos in six days.
changed_reading.after: Creation is portrayed as measured and temporally apportioned accomplishment.

baseline_models.mechanism: Upper realm, lower realm, and the interval or connection between them form one coordinated created totality.

activation_trace.role: What is overhead and sheltering supplies the upper pole.
The lower realm opposed to sky supplies the lower pole.
The middle interval includes the full expanse between the poles.
The connective relation keeps the poles and middle from reading as an empty list.

changed_reading.after: The upper, lower, and entire intervening field are one relationally ordered creation.

baseline_models.mechanism: The contact verb and fatigue noun deny not only collapse after work but even the arrival of a weakening effect.

activation_trace.role: Contact as the incidence of an effect makes weariness something that could reach an agent.
Weakness and fatigue name the effect categorically denied.

changed_reading.before: God did not become tired after creation.
changed_reading.after: No weakening effect even reached the creator through the completed work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question whether first creation caused incapacity, followed by the audience's problem with new creation, turns the focus denial into a capacity premise: originating creation depleted nothing, so renewal is no new burden.

activation_trace.role: The denied incidence of an effect supplies the no-depletion premise.
Fatigue is the precise incapacity excluded by the premise.
Inability to find or execute the course makes divine capacity the explicit question.
The same creative root names first and renewed bringing-into-being.
New occurrence after a break specifies creation as renewal.

structural_cues: 50:15 opposes the first creation to a new creation inside a rhetorical incapacity question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies first/new creation, an incapacity question, and denied fatigue; I infer the denial is evidence for recurrence. Alternatively, the two assertions may remain parallel displays of power rather than a formal argument.

changed_reading.before: The first cosmic creation caused no fatigue.
changed_reading.after: Its failure to deplete capacity underwrites the possibility of renewed creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A gapless built sky sends water into planted earth, reviving dead land and explicitly modeling emergence; the focus totality becomes an active vertical life-system, not static scenery.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky supplies the system's upper source.
The lower earth supplies its receiving and emerging field.
Connection between the poles allows movement through the created span.
Joining parts into a building gives the sky coherent construction.
The source negates opened gaps, marking that construction as unruptured.
Sending something down supplies directed transfer from the upper realm.
Causative planting turns descent into growth in the lower realm.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation names the system's reviving result.
Emergence to the outside makes that result an explicit model for resurrection.

structural_cues: 50:6-11 sequences sky construction, descent, germination, revival, then 'thus the emergence'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered sequence and explicit emergence analogy; I infer that this traffic functionally fills 'between them.' Alternatively, the interval may remain spatial while the life-cycle serves as a separate proof.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a completed cosmic totality.
changed_reading.after: That totality is a continuing heaven-to-earth production system that rehearses emergence from death.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after divine weariness is denied, creaturely patience and praise are distributed across solar boundaries, night, and the aftermath of prostration; created time becomes a cadence of response to inexhaustibility.

activation_trace.role: Duration makes time a salient created framework.
Denied fatigue distinguishes divine capacity from effortful creaturely endurance.
Holding the self from distress supplies the human endurance response.
Exoneration turns the no-fatigue claim into liturgical transcendence.
Praise supplies the affirmative complement to exoneration.
Night extends the response beyond daylight boundaries.
The end or aftermath of an act adds another recurring temporal edge.

structural_cues: 50:39 begins with fa immediately after the focus, then schedules praise before sunrise, before sunset, at night, and after prostration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence and repeated time markers; I infer divine non-fatigue grounds sustained human practice while contrasting creaturely patience. Alternatively, the command may answer hostile speech without interpreting the creation interval.

changed_reading.before: The six days are only a chronology of creation.
changed_reading.after: Created duration also frames a repeated human rhythm of patience, exoneration, and praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same lower earth opens, people issue rapidly, the whole group is driven to one destination, and the operation is called easy; no-fatigue becomes present operational ease in reassembly.

activation_trace.role: The created lower realm is the material field later reopened.
Denied weakness supplies the capacity frame.
The same earth now yields those held within it.
Splitting open supplies the release mechanism.
The opposite of slowness specifies the release as rapid.
Driving and collecting a group to a destination specifies total reassembly.
Ease after difficulty explicitly removes operational strain.

structural_cues: 50:44 compresses earth-opening, rapid exit, gathering, and ease into one ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same earth, opening, speed, gathering, and ease; I infer that they operationalize the earlier capacity denial. Alternatively, 'easy' may qualify gathering narrowly rather than all creation.

changed_reading.after: Reopening earth and gathering all beings are likewise rapid and effortless.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant و س م mapping under focus س م و. It remains anchored to the exact focus inventory and is reinforced by sky-water-germination context; render it as an exploratory image, not a replacement etymology or translation.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with vegetation turns the focus sky token into an imprinting image.
The repeated sky token places that marking image at the source of the rain sequence.
Directed descent carries the prospective mark toward earth.
Water supplies the material that makes the mark productive.
Caused growth renders the rain-mark visibly on earth.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth are named as created regions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sky-earth span is also a marking circuit: descending water inscribes earth with growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the prolonged-pursuit image of لغوب rather than its ordinary fatigue branch. It remains anchored to the exact focus branch and gains a mechanism from driving, rapidity, and gathering; render it only as a secondary kinetic analogy.

activation_trace.role: Prolonged pursuit supplies the strange kinetic sense of what the negation excludes.
Driving and impelling introduces directed retrieval rather than aimless pursuit.
Rapidity removes prolongation from the retrieval.
Gathering a group to one destination supplies the completed endpoint.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, cosmic retrieval is no prolonged exhausting chase: beings are driven and gathered rapidly.

strongest_changes: 50:15 turns denied weariness into evidence that renewed creation cannot exhaust capacity.
50:6-11 makes the heaven-earth span a productive rain-growth-revival system.
50:44 extends the denial into rapid, easy reassembly.
summary.what_was_special: The contact-negation makes weariness not merely absent after creation but unable to reach the creator; context then converts that claim into resurrection capacity and a rhythm of praise.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the six days primarily mark measured stages or only bounded duration.
Whether the post-focus praise schedule intentionally rereads the creation interval or is only a neighboring response.
The و س م and pursuit activations are packet-grounded but remain form-distant exploratory images.
